question: Approve the design and enter implementation as Pilot? Approving accepts D1 to D5 as recommended: D1 ship the review-round count as a last, droppable slice; D2 chief-engineer owed at four repair passes; D3 accept the four engineering-reviewer cases no count sees, with no Reverses: line, and read the next batch for a repeat; D4 the engineering-reviewer goes to Fable on profile: prod or a db surface only, not on merge or authority changes (narrower than the Captain's item 1, which named secrets and merge or authority rules); D5 run stage 1 of the ADR 0021 D1 evaluation (reading only, no model) and decide stage 2 on its result.

artifacts.summary: Design measured on 38 window tasks and 287 overall across four repositories: chief-engineer owed at four repair passes (stage-report headings), 10 fires, 9 of 9 owed caught, 0 false (today 5); engineering-reviewer keeps amendment detection, clears by date; cost 0.25 Opus calls per task (today 0.18). Four engineering-reviewer cases (including captain-question-load and the #677 fix) no count sees. Model: Fable on prod or db (2 of 9 window fires), Opus otherwise; secrets have no field and the merge or authority path signal marks 31 of 38 tasks, so neither picks Fable. Security reviewer: stage 1 reading of 10 saved reports against 26 later findings, stage 2 reruns only on an escape (about 40 USD assumed). README unchanged; AC-1 to AC-9.
